annotations.title: Look up an MCP server on this register

description: Returns one record (not a list). Look up what this register already holds about an MCP endpoint: whether it is watched, how often it is re-measured, how many measurements exist, when the first and latest were taken, and the latest verdict with the record_sha256 you can recompute yourself. Reads stored measurements only. It contacts nothing and measures nothing, so use check_conformance for a fresh reading. An endpoint that is absent is reported as absent and that is NOT a negative verdict: it means nobody has measured it here, not that it failed.

endpoint.description: https URL of the MCP endpoint to look up, exactly as it appears on the register

name: lookup_server

outputSchema.description: Returns one record (not a list): what this register holds for the single endpoint you named. Fields after on_register depend on its value: an absent endpoint carries register_size, how_to_appear and fresh_reading; an endpoint on the register carries the rest.

added_at.description: On the register: when the row was added, or null if not recorded.

alerted_on_change.description: On the register: whether someone asked to be notified when the row changes.

cadence.description: On the register: how often it is re-measured (weekly or daily).

does_not_mean.description: What this answer must not be read as.

endpoint.description: The endpoint you asked about, echoed.

first_measured_at.description: On the register: time of the first stored measurement, or null.

fresh_reading.description: Absent endpoint only: how to measure it right now.

full_history_url.description: On the register: URL of the complete history for this endpoint.

history.description: On the register: the most recent stored measurements, oldest first, at most 20.

history_truncated.description: On the register: true when history leaves out older measurements.

how_to_appear.description: Absent endpoint only: how anyone can add it to the register.

last_measured_at.description: On the register: time of the latest stored measurement, or null.

latest.description: On the register: the latest stored measurement as a summary with its record_sha256, or null if none.

measurements.description: On the register: how many measurements are stored for this endpoint.

on_register.description: true = this endpoint is on the register. false = the register was READ and this endpoint is not on it. If the register could not be read at all, this field is not returned: the call comes back as a tool error (isError), because absence and not-knowing are different answers.

register_size.description: Absent endpoint only: how many endpoints are on the watchlist.

standing.description: On the register: measured, or a sentence saying it is watched and not yet measured.

tier.description: On the register: free, paid or self. The verdict is the same for every tier.

title: Look up an MCP server on this register
